message.content:
The most‑visited market in New York City is **Union Square Greenmarket**.  
It’s the city’s flagship farmers’‑market, drawing roughly 1.5 million visitors each year (estimates vary between 1.2–1.8 million depending on the source).  

Other popular markets include:

| Market | Approx. annual visitors |
|--------|--------------------------|
| Chelsea Market | ~1.0 million |
| Brooklyn Flea (Williamsburg) | ~800 k |
| Grand Central Market | ~600 k |

If you’re looking for a specific year or month, let me know and I can dig up the latest figures.
